name: Tech
summary: Builds the club's products and runs study jams, workshops and hackathon teams across web, backend, AI and data.
requirements: Git, Firebase or Cloud is a plus

name: Operations & HR
summary: Keeps the club running: plans events, handles logistics, and looks after members from recruitment to recognition.
requirements: Good at communicating and connecting people

name: Marketing & Communications
summary: Tells the club's story: writes, designs and shoots everything the community sees.
requirements: Writing and editing, research and fact-checking
An understanding of student audiences, English communication
Visual concepts for posts and publications
Photoshop, Illustrator, Procreate or Canva; typography, layout, colour
openTo: Students of VinUniversity and other universities

name: Community Members
summary: The open door: join events when you want, get early access and updates, no department duties.
openTo: Anyone who wants to learn with us
